# 1. Charter / Expand Casa di San Giorgio & Piacenza Clearinghouse (up to tier 4)
oe_plat_dec_charter_san_giorgio = {
	decision_category = oe_cat_economic_canals
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		oe_plat_is_host = yes
		OR = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_plat_arsenal_tier }
			AND = {
				has_variable = oe_plat_arsenal_tier
				var:oe_plat_arsenal_tier < 4
			}
		}
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_plat_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		gold >= 150
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_plat_bank_cd }
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:burghers background = pop_type:nobles } }
	option = {
		name = oe_plat_dec_charter_san_giorgio.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_plat_dec_charter_san_giorgio_tt
			oe_plat_host_init = yes
			add_gold = -150
			set_variable = { name = oe_plat_bank_cd months = 96 }
			change_variable = { name = oe_plat_arsenal_tier add = 1 }
			clamp_variable = { name = oe_plat_arsenal_tier min = 0 max = 4 }
			oe_plat_shift_oligarchy = { delta = 10 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_plat_san_giorgio_charter_mod years = 25 mode = replace }
			if = {
				limit = { tag = GEN NOT = { has_reform = government_reform:oe_plat_ref_casa_san_giorgio_bank } }
				add_reform = government_reform:oe_plat_ref_casa_san_giorgio_bank
			}
		}
	}
}

# 3. Open the Libro d'Oro for New-Citizen Constitutionalism (one-time)
oe_plat_dec_open_libro_doro = {
	decision_category = oe_cat_imperial_governance
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		oe_plat_is_host = yes
		NOT = { var:oe_plat_libro_open ?= 1 }
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_plat_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		is_subject = no
		stability >= 5
		current_year >= 1600
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = { event_illustration_poptype_effect = { foreground = pop_type:burghers background = pop_type:nobles } }
	option = {
		name = oe_plat_dec_open_libro_doro.a
		effect = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_plat_dec_open_libro_doro_tt
			oe_plat_host_init = yes
			set_variable = { name = oe_plat_libro_open value = 1 }
			oe_plat_shift_oligarchy = { delta = -20 }
			oe_plat_add_civic_tradition = { val = 10 }
			add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = estate_satisfaction_mild_bonus }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_plat_open_libro_mod years = 40 mode = replace }
		}
	}
}
